# Content: New Chain Cards and Retro-fitting

## Summary

Create new event chain cards in `card-data.csv` and retro-fit existing event cards into story chains.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. **Chain 1: Tax Escalation** (3-step cycle, resets)
   - `Error in Tax Return` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) `Tax Audit`
   - `Tax Audit` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) `Inquiry Commission`
   - `Inquiry Commission` → (accept) `Error in Tax Return`, (reject) chain ends
2. **Chain 2: Labor Unrest** (2-step, no reset)
   - `Service Workers Strike` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) `General Strike`
   - `General Strike` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) chain ends
3. **Chain 3: Restaurant Opportunity** (2-step, no reset)
   - `Popular Menu Item` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) `Farm-to-Table Feature`
   - `Farm-to-Table Feature` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) chain ends
4. **Chain 4: Economic Downturn** (2-step, no reset)
   - `Recession` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) `Depression`
   - `Depression` → (accept) chain ends, (reject) chain ends
5. **Retro-fit existing cards** where sensible story chains exist (e.g., `Tax Audit` → linked to `Error in Tax Return`; `Flu Outbreak` → health crisis chain).
6. **Non-chain events unchanged** — Cards like "Local Festival", "Food Critic Visit", "Rainy Day" remain unaffected.
7. **All chain cards have correct effects** — Negative events reduce coins/revenue; positive events increase revenue/rep.

## Key Files:

- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — New chain card rows, retro-fitted existing events

## Dependencies

- Depends on data model (CG-0MTT7DUJE002HPPM)

## Deliverables

- 6 new chain card definitions in CSV
- Retro-fitted existing event cards with chain links
- Producer review of card effects and names (if not already approved)
data.title: Content: New chain cards and retro-fitting

# Add `upgradeCostDiscount` to CSV schema

## Context
The integer-economy migration scaled coin values ×100, but `upgradeCostDiscount` was never added to the CSV schema. This task adds the column and updates the parser infrastructure so the Financial Advisor can carry its discount value.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `src/balance-cards/csv.ts`: `CsvRow` interface includes `readonly upgradeCostDiscount?: number`.
2. `src/balance-cards/csv.ts`: `CSV_COLUMNS` array includes `upgradeCostDiscount` immediately after `peekOncePerTurn` and before `art_notes`.
3. `src/balance-cards/csv.ts`: `NUMERIC_COLUMNS` includes `upgradeCostDiscount`.
4. `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` header row includes `upgradeCostDiscount` at the correct position.
5. `card-data.csv` `staff-financial` row carries `upgradeCostDiscount = 100`.
6. `card-data.csv` header column count matches `CSV_COLUMNS.length` (all existing tests pass).
7. `balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts`: column-count assertions updated; parse round-trip succeeds for staff rows.

## Key Files
- `src/balance-cards/csv.ts` — CsvRow, CSV_COLUMNS, NUMERIC_COLUMNS
- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — header and staff-financial row
- `tests/main-street/balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts` — column-count assertions
data.title: CSV schema: add upgradeCostDiscount column to CsvRow and card-data.csv

# Fix staff description text for ×100 consistency (non-implemented effects)

## Context
Several staff card descriptions still reference pre-migration single-digit values (`1`). This task corrects the text only — IT Specialist and Delivery Driver effects remain unimplemented (documented as such).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `card-data.csv` `staff-accountant` description: "cost 1 less" → "cost 100 less" (also done in Task 2, idempotent).
2. `card-data.csv` `staff-it` description: "Reduces this business refresh cost by 1." → "Reduces this business refresh cost by 100." (description only, effect not implemented).
3. `card-data.csv` `staff-event-planner` description: "+1 synergy coin per turn" → "+100 synergy coin per turn".
4. `card-data.csv` `staff-financial` description: "Reduces this business upgrade cost by 1." → "Reduces this business upgrade cost by 100." (effect implemented in Task 5).
5. `card-data.csv` `staff-delivery` description: already reads "by 50" — no change needed (confirmed correct).
6. Each description that references an unimplemented effect includes a note in the CSV `art_notes` or a comment explaining the gap is intentional (follow-up work item).
7. `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`: staff ability/description columns corrected for all four cards.

## Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — staff rows: accountant, it, event-planner, financial, delivery
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`
data.title: Fix staff description text for ×100 consistency (non-implemented effects)

# Fix Accountant refreshCostDiscount value to ×100 scale

## Context
The Accountant has `refreshCostDiscount = 1` in `card-data.csv` and description text saying "makes investment refreshes cost 1 less". After the ×100 coin migration, this should be `100` to match the integer-economy convention.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `card-data.csv` `staff-accountant` row: `refreshCostDiscount` = `100` (was `1`).
2. `card-data.csv` `staff-accountant` description updated from "…cost 1 less…" to "…cost 100 less…".
3. `tests/main-street/refresh-market.test.ts`: updated expectations use `100` instead of `1`; test passes.
4. `tests/main-street/balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts`: updated expectations where they reference Accountant value.
5. `tests/main-street/group-f-staff-abilities-expansion.test.ts`: updated expectations where they reference Accountant value.
6. `MainStreetMarketRefill.refreshMarketCost()` correctly computes `REFRESH_MARKET_COST - 100` with an employed Accountant.
7. `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`: Accountant description column corrected to "cost 100 less" (also covered in Task 3).

## Key Files
- `example-games/main-street/card-data.csv` — staff-accountant row
- `tests/main-street/refresh-market.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/balance-cards-csv-pipeline.test.ts`
- `tests/main-street/group-f-staff-abilities-expansion.test.ts`
- `example-games/main-street/MainStreetMarketRefill.ts`
- `docs/main-street/card-catalog.md`

## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callback condition registration.** `registerStorylineOptions` accepts an optional `condition: (state: MainStreetState) => boolean` on each `StorylineOption`. Options whose condition returns `false` are omitted from the presented option list at draw time. *Metric: unit tests for condition true/false/derived-state scenarios.*
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback conditions are evaluated when the option list is compiled (at draw time), NOT at resolution time. Mutating state between draw and resolution does not change the presented option list. *Metric: unit test.*
- **No condition defined.** Option behaves identically to legacy behaviour (always included). *Metric: legacy-equivalence test.*
- **Condition receives full MainStreetState.** Callback type parameter matches MainStreetState shape. *Metric: unit test verifying state shape.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC1 (Callback condition registration), AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time), AC5 (Game-agnostic seam).
data.title: Test: callback conditions on storyline options

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callback successor registration.** `registerStorylineOptions` accepts an optional `successorResolver: (state: MainStreetState) => string | null | undefined` on each `StorylineOption`. When the player selects the option, the callback is invoked at resolution time to determine the pushed successor card. *Metric: unit tests assert correct successor push from callback output.*
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback successors are evaluated at resolution time only (the player has already committed). *Metric: unit test.*
- **Null/undefined returns.** `null` and `undefined` from callback end the chain. *Metric: unit test.*
- **No successorResolver.** Falls back to option.successorId (legacy behaviour). *Metric: legacy-equivalence test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC2 (Callback successor registration), AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time), AC5 (Game-agnostic seam).
data.title: Test: callback successors on storyline options

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution.** Callback conditions are evaluated when the option list is compiled (at draw time), NOT at resolution time, because the description explicitly states callbacks must not be trusted to stay stable between draw and resolution. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Options with false condition omitted.** Options with `condition: () => false` are omitted from the presented list. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Options with true condition included.** Options with `condition: () => true` are included. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Registry copy safety.** Filtering does not mutate the stored registry entries. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Legacy options unchanged.** Options without `condition` are unaffected. *Metric: unit test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC3 (Callbacks evaluated at draw time, not resolution), AC4 (Declarative path remains default).
data.title: Filter options by condition at compile/draw time

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **Declarative path remains default.** When no callback successorResolver is present, falls back to option.successorId (legacy behaviour unchanged). *Metric: unit test.*
- **resolveStorylineOption invokes successorResolver.** When present, callback is called and its return used as the pushed successor. *Metric: unit test.*
- **Null/undefined handling.** Null/undefined from callback ends the chain (no card pushed). *Metric: unit test.*
- **Effect policy still applies.** Effect is resolved before successor is determined. *Metric: unit test.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC4 (Declarative path remains default), AC2 (Callback successor registration).
data.title: Invoke successorResolver at resolution time

data.description:
## Acceptance Criteria
- **AI compatibility.** The AI path (`decideEventChoice`) selects only from the presented option list, which is already filtered by `condition` at draw time. No AI code changes are required. *Metric: Monte Carlo and regression harness run to completion with callback-equipped storylines.*
- **Declarative path remains default.** Existing storylines without callbacks behave identically to pre-change behaviour. *Metric: regression harness.*
- **Full game flow with callbacks.** A callback-equipped storyline works end-to-end from draw to resolution. *Metric: integration test.*
- **Full test suite passes.** All existing tests pass with the new changes. *Metric: `vitest` passes.*

**Parent ACs covered:** AC4 (Declarative path remains default), AC6 (AI compatibility), AC7 (Full project test suite passes).
data.title: Integration, AI compatibility, and legacy equivalence tests

## Why

The post-release verification item MS-0MURKQJDG007C3MG cannot run because its
declared dependency — the `dev -> main` release — has never happened.
`origin/main` is at `2beed0a` (2026-09-27), 60 commits behind `origin/dev`, and
does not contain `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. GitHub reports zero registered
workflows, zero runs, zero deployments, and
`https://thewizardscode.github.io/tce-main-street/` returns HTTP 404. GitHub
Pages is enabled (`build_type: workflow`) but has never built.

discovered-from:MS-0MURKQJDG007C3MG
blocker-for:MS-0MURKQJDG007C3MG

## Goal

Perform the `dev -> main` release (ship skill, no `--skip-checks`) so the GitHub
Pages deploy workflow in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` triggers on the `main`
push and publishes `https://thewizardscode.github.io/tce-main-street/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **1.** The ship skill's `dev -> main` release completes and `main` contains
  `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.
- **2.** A `Deploy to GitHub Pages` workflow run triggers on the resulting
  `main` push and completes green; the run URL is recorded.
- **3.** The resulting run URL is reported on MS-0MURKQJDG007C3MG so the
  live-verification ACs there can be executed.

## Notes

- Producer action: only the release process advances `main`; agents must not
  push to `main` directly.
- The earlier ship audit-gate blockers (3 of 4) are now `completed`/`in_review`;
  `MS-0MUI7ZJK8003HY9J` remains `blocked`/`plan_complete` and may still need
  recovery before the release gate is satisfiable.
data.title: Run dev -> main release to publish Main Street Pages site
